findings.affected_surface: Step 3d foreman environment filtering and acceptance case (f)
findings.claim: Excluding C only from the AUTOPILOT_* allowlist leaves explicit environment passthrough able to restore an inherited child id.
findings.evidence: The plan specifies the allowlist exclusion at approximately lines 345-352. The separate loop at lines 355-358 appends requested environment variables and excludes only AUTOPILOT_SESSION_ID. Replaying these loops with the proposed allowlist exclusion and --env-passthrough AUTOPILOT_CHILD_SESSION_ID still produces AUTOPILOT_CHILD_SESSION_ID=inherited-C in FOREMAN_ENV. The hand receives that array through env -i; the helper's unset array is not applied to it.
findings.evidence_reference: Plan §4 step 3d foreman launch row and acceptance (f); scripts/dispatch-foreman.sh:351-358,367-371,409; hooks/tests/dispatch-runner-session-id-scrub.test.sh:168-174.
findings.repair: Explicitly exclude AUTOPILOT_CHILD_SESSION_ID from both the allowlist and --env-passthrough paths, or remove it from the completed launch environment. Add acceptance and mutation controls for both routes.

findings.claim: Routing live probe branches through the helper does not scrub the earlier runner-version launches.
findings.evidence: Before the live branches cited at lines 388-489, the probe executes codex, agy, grok, qoderclicn, cursor-agent, claude, kimi and opencode with --version at lines 181-252. These launches inherit the probe environment and precede the current child-session helper calls. The revision specifies routing live branches through the helper but gives no removal boundary for these earlier invocations. A probe started with inherited C therefore can still pass it to an unnamed runner process, including when no live probe runs.
findings.evidence_reference: Plan §4 step 3d probe launch row and acceptance (f); scripts/probe-engine-capability.sh:175-252,388-489.
findings.repair: Specify C removal before the first runner invocation or wrap every version and live invocation with the scrub. Assert C absence on every stub invocation, including --version and the path without a live command, and demonstrate a targeted negative control.

findings.affected_surface: Step 3d detached fallback acceptance and mutation controls
findings.claim: The detached negative control removes two protections together and does not independently verify the fallback scrub.
findings.evidence: The revision adds C removal to both child_session_env_setup and the helper-absent fallback. Its negative control removes the helper from detach serialization while also requiring the fallback to lack C removal. The ordinary detached acceptance case uses the helper, so deleting only the fallback's C removal leaves that case green.
findings.evidence_reference: Plan §4 step 3d mechanism, acceptance (f) and negative controls; scripts/dispatch-hetero.sh:3653,4971.
findings.repair: Add an acceptance case that deliberately selects the helper-absent fallback and checks C absence. Remove only the fallback's C scrub in that case and require red, then restore it and require green.
